snippet.title: SONIC PICO PARK - New Character Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
As revealed on our 35th Anniversary Birthday Livestream, Shadow the Hedgehog and Sonic Pico Cat are joining SONIC PICO PARK as playable characters.

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4304060/
